messages:
Liam (AE): Heads up — Solstice POC kickoff scheduled Thu 9am PT. Starting this thread to finalize kickoff agenda, success criteria, and any hard blockers.

Sofia (SE): I can present a live demo + perf snapshot. Need to confirm target dataset size (docs & user messages) and expected query mix.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Planning to run two eval tracks: closed-book FAQ accuracy + open-ended summarization. Will prepare 40 canonical prompts + 40 adversarial.

Ethan (CISO): Security checklist first pass: SAML SSO required, retention choices (30/90/365), encryption + KMS, contract addendum for data handling, and whether they will send any customer PII.

Liam (AE): From intake: they selected SSO, expect 90d retention, and said no PII initially. Will confirm again in kickoff.

Jordan (Sales Ops): Pricing note — Solstice asked about short POC commit (3 weeks). We should prepare: (1) 2-week reserved block quote, (2) PAYG quote. Also list minimum commit to reach target unit cost.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposed success metrics to align on:
- Answer quality: >= 80% helpful on customer-labeled FAQ set (n=100) OR F1 >= 0.7 on closed-book QA.
- Hallucination tolerance: <= 5% critical hallucinations on eval set.
- Ingestion latency: new doc available to search/generation < 4 minutes.
- Latency: p95 < 500ms for 1.5k token queries under baseline traffic.
- Throughput: sustain 15 RPS with p99 < 1s.

Sofia (SE): We should also capture UX acceptance criteria: answer format consistency (bulleted vs narrative), citations present when sourceable, and a human-review flag for low confidence (<0.4).

Priya (Solutions Eng): Eval artifacts to share today: prompt file, ground-truth labels, locust rate-script, and a small ingestion script (python).

Sofia (SE): Sample eval command I will demo:
```bash
python -m redwood_eval.run --env staging --prompts data/solstice_prompts.json --out results/solstice_eval.json
```
Prompts include fields: id, input_text, expected_answer, score_type.

Ethan (CISO): If they require VPC/private deployment for the trial, provisioning estimate = ~72 hours. Hosted dedicated with SAML can be ready in <24h. Flagging for kickoff.

Jordan (Sales Ops): For contract logistics: include billing cadence options (monthly invoice or CC), PO acceptance, and any prepayment for reserved blocks. I ll have draft numbers by EOD.

Liam (AE): Timeline suggestion: Day 0 (kickoff) align criteria and access. Day 1-2 ingest + baseline. Day 3-5 tuning and mid-eval. Day 6 final eval + review. Decision end of Day 7.

Priya (Solutions Eng): One operational blocker: if Solstice insists on KMS integration with their HSM, security team needs to approve and that can add days. Need confirmation tomorrow.

Ethan (CISO): Also: if they ask for SOC2 artifacts / custom DPA terms, legal lead needs 3-5 business days. Call that out.

Liam (AE): Action items before kickoff:
- Sofia: perf snapshot + demo notes (ASAP)
- Priya: upload eval prompts + ingestion script (EOD)
- Jordan: two pricing sketches (reserved vs PAYG) by tomorrow morning
- Ethan: one-pager security checklist to share with customer

invite-bot: Meeting scheduled: Solstice POC Kickoff — Thu 2026-01-15 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to Solstice (eng, security, product) + Redwood participants.

Sofia (SE): I ll also attach a short test dataset (5k docs) to the invite so they can sanity-check schemas.

Priya (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I ll post the canonical prompts here when uploaded.

Liam (AE): Great — if nothing else, I ll send the finalized agenda and attendee list in 30 minutes.

Jordan (Sales Ops): Ack. Will include note on expected commit levels to hit target unit price.

Ethan (CISO): I ll be on the kickoff and will bring the quick security checklist.

Sofia (SE): Quick Q: do we want to include a rollback/fallback plan in case ingestion fails? Suggest we add fallback to last-indexed snapshot.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Good idea. Add to agenda under operational readiness.

Liam (AE): Perfect. Closing thread for now — please flag urgent changes here.
